purpose: Teach: あゆみ/つきあっ/すさまじい/このほど/とかく/ぬけ/かれこれ/めちゃめちゃ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の十年のあゆみ、振り返りたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'd love to look back on these ten years of the shop with you.
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. Nostalgic tone, searching gently into the past. Unhurried pacing. Slight upward lift at the end—inviting her in, not deciding alone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店と長くつきあってくださってるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's really something, how long our customers have stuck with us and the shop.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Steady, grounded delivery. A small smile in the voice without forcing it. Warmth that comes from noticing others, not from saying something clever.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、すさまじい勢いで召し上がってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were eating at an amazing pace—couldn't keep up with the orders.
lines.style: Bright, almost laughing energy. Quick tempo. Light and a little amazed. The voice lifts as she tells it—she's watching it happen again right now.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、このほどお店のSNSフォロワーが千人超えたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just recently our store's social media followers hit over a thousand.
lines.style: Genuine pleasure, delivered matter-of-factly. No false modesty, but no boasting either. A fact she's proud of. Steady, even pacing. Slight warmth on the accomplishment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューはとかく不評ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu items just haven't been landing the way we hoped.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little uncertain. Slower pace. She's turning this over in her mind while speaking. Quiet concern underneath—not regret, but wondering. Soft trailing-off.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お皿の汁がぬけてしまったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One customer's soup actually dripped right off their plate.
lines.style: Wry amusement. Light, almost conspiratorial tone. A small laugh threaded through. She's not criticizing—just noticing the absurdity of it. Dry delivery, like she's seen stranger things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、かれこれ三年お見えになるわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That one customer has been coming for close to three years now.
lines.style: Warmth mixed with fondness. Gentle observation, like she's been counting without meaning to. Steady voice, grounded. A little soft—noticing loyalty matters to her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のお褒め、めちゃめちゃ嬉しかったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: When that customer complimented the place, I was so happy I could barely contain it.
lines.style: Openly delighted. Faster pace than before—the happiness speeds her up. Genuine, unguarded. The kind of joy that comes from being seen and appreciated. Warmth in every word, close and immediate.
